verdict.rationale: Docs and probes confirm Cognee is open source and can be self-hosted via a documented single Docker command (docker run cognee/cognee:main), with local UI/pipeline execution (start_ui()) requiring no cloud account, plus runtime probes confirming local execution without any external dependency. Pricing page explicitly states 'Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.' Missing for 10: independent third-party report of a full production self-hosted deployment beyond docs/probes.
